---
name: Epic
about: Track a multi-phase initiative that spans several issues
title: "[Epic] "
labels: ["epic"]
assignees: []
---

## Vision
What is this initiative, and what does "done" look like at the end of all phases?

## Why this matters
The user or app need this serves. Frame the value of the whole initiative, not any single phase.

## Approach
High-level strategy. Note key external dependencies (APIs, services), data model
changes, and any cross-cutting concerns (caching, performance, security) that span phases.

## Phases
Child issues, in suggested order. GitHub renders this as a tracked task list with progress.

- [ ] #<phase-1-issue> Phase 1 — <short description>
- [ ] #<phase-2-issue> Phase 2 — <short description>
- [ ] #<phase-3-issue> Phase 3 — <short description>

## Out of scope
What this epic intentionally does not cover.

## Notes
Open questions, validation to do early, or things to revisit as phases land.
